sections.what: Make **Environment** a feature *family*: an umbrella page over subpages. Environment covers light, heat/temperature, time/weather/sun/moon/seasons/forecast, plus the world-building cluster (worldpainter, areas, ways, connections, scopes, item placement, biomes, heightmaps, settlements, interiors, structures).
sections.why: Environment spans many independent authoring surfaces - light has its own inspector + Engine Config sliders, weather its own schedule, heat its own config. The Feature Map splits it across rows 23/24/25/36. One page is unreadable; the reader should be able to land on 'Environment' and navigate down.
sections.how: Umbrella page per the new standard, linking its family; each subpage follows the standard. Decide the boundary with World Building (the Map already treats WorldPainter/Grid-to-Graph/Scopes as editor features).
sections.verify:
